summary: Computes the remaining session time as the session-time threshold minus the elapsed session time, and formats it as a countdown clock string (" MM:SS.FFF") into a caller-supplied buffer. Suppressed when the session type is 7 (qualifying/time-attack) or championship mode is active, and when the remaining time is not positive or the race time offset has not yet been passed. Always returns 0.

operations.description: Copy the format prefix string asc_5CCE54 into the output buffer a1 and retain the destination pointer for later formatting.
Guard: if session type dword_7C56A4 equals 7 (qualifying/time-attack), return 0 without formatting.
Guard: if championship mode dword_7D0410 equals 1, return 0 without formatting.
Compute remaining time v3 as flt_8ACF94 minus dbl_8AFEA0 and store it into the a1 buffer as a float value.
Guard: if remaining time v3 is not positive, or the race time offset flt_8ACF90 has reached the session time dbl_8AFEA0, return 0 without formatting.
Call SpatialGridCell with the remaining time as float input, converting it into minute/second components held in local integer and float slots used for formatting.
Call StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck to format the buffer as " MM:SS.FFF" using the computed minute/second components and the remaining time.
